title: SourceRecord
description: Schema for source cards and raw source registry records in the AI Agents Learning Wiki.

id.description: Unique stable identifier for the source (e.g., S01, S02).

title.description: Original academic paper or official documentation title.

authors.description: List of primary authors or organizational contributors.

publisher.description: Publisher, conference venue, or hosting organization.

access_date.description: Date when the source was retrieved and verified (YYYY-MM-DD).

retrieval_status.description: Verification status of the source retrieval.

http_status.description: HTTP response status code during retrieval.

summary.description: Objective summary of the source and its relevance to AI agents.

key_topics.description: List of architectural or conceptual topics covered.

verified_sections.description: Exact section or chapter names identified in the source.

copyright_notice.description: Redistribution and copyright policy note (fair use / metadata only).
